title: docsync configuration
description: Validated configuration for the Automated Documentation Sync engine. Load order: config file -> DOCSYNC_* env vars -> defaults.

jira_base_url.description: Base URL of the Jira instance, e.g. https://jira.company.com

jira.description: Legacy nested form; base_url is normalised into jira_base_url.

mcp_api_key.description: Shared API key required by the MCP server for authorization.

mcp_rate_limit_per_minute.description: Per-client token-bucket refill rate for MCP tool calls.

max_context_tokens.description: Token budget used to truncate story content before LLM calls.
